title: Exponential decay of mass for inertial coalescing particles with Hamiltonian noise
summary: We study a system of $N$ inertial particles on a two-dimensional torus $\T^2$, evolving under a second-order stochastic dynamics with position-dependent friction $λ$ and noise amplitude $σ$, and undergoing coalescence at rate $R_0$ when their distance falls below a threshold $δ$. In the joint small-mass / small-correlation limit $μ(\eps)\to 0$, $μ(\eps)/\eps\to\al\in(0,\infty)$, the empirical measure of the surviving particles converges to a stochastic continuity equation with inertial drift~$g_\al$.
